lines.text: The whole council led Jesus to Pilate and accused Him of forbidding taxes to Caesar and calling Himself a King.
Pilate found no basis for a charge, learned Jesus was a Galilean, and sent Him to Herod in Jerusalem.
Herod was greatly pleased to see Jesus and hoped He would preach a sermon, but Jesus gave no answer.
Herod and Pilate became friends that day, and the crowd cried out for Pilate to release Malchus instead of Jesus.
Barabbas was imprisoned for insurrection and murder, and Pilate released him and handed Jesus over to their will.
